library.confirm.message: SavePoint takes snapshots of everything in these folders. When you switch profiles, it makes the folders match that profile: it puts files back and removes files that profile doesn't have. It also leaves a small file in each folder to remember you chose it. No snapshot is taken now: you take the first one yourself when you make a profile. Make sure these are the right folders.
